Distribution. This species has been recorded as far northwest as Zayü Co. China (Jäch et al. 2012) and south and east through Myanmar, Thailand, Laos, Vietnam, Malaysia, and Indonesia far as Java and Borneo (Ochs 1927, 1930; Gustafson & Miller 2016). Habitat. It has been found in small, forested streams with elevations above 100 m a. s. l. and up to 1,000 m a. s. l. (Ochs 1927; Gustafson & Miller 2016). Ochs (1927) reported that P. marginatus was found in unpolluted localities and always near the water’s edge in the shallower parts of the streams. We found this species only in streams with shaded areas and slow current with substrates including pebble, gravel and sand (Fig. 7 H), at elevations ranging from 11 to 1,800 m a. s. l., but most often at 100 – 900 m a. s. l.
